# EGY CINEMA

> Free Arabic-language streaming app for movies and TV shows on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. Built with Flutter, backed by Supabase.

## What it is

EGY CINEMA is a desktop and mobile streaming aggregator for Egyptian and Arab cinema enthusiasts. It pulls metadata from TMDB, indexes it in a custom Supabase database, and plays content through embedded players.

- Audience: Arabic-speaking film and TV enthusiasts, primarily in Egypt and the wider Arab world
- Languages: Arabic (default, RTL native) and English
- Platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS
- Cost: Free, no subscription, no ads inside the player
- Account: optional for browsing, required for watchlist, favorites, and Watch Together sync

## Features

- Watchlist: save titles to watch later, synced to your account
- Favorites: bookmark films you love
- Search: real-time, server-side, full title database
- Recent history: pick up where you left off on any signed-in device
- Watch Together: synchronized playback with a friend, both pause at the same second
- Picture-in-Picture and zoom: watch while working, crop black bars
- Arabic UI: right-to-left native, not translated

## Stack

- Client: Flutter (Cairo typography throughout)
- Backend: Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime)
- Metadata: TMDB API + custom OMDb proxy for IMDB IDs
- Source: https://github.com/Youssf-Mohamed/movie_app
